name: MDMA
tierNotes: Threshold: lights slightly juicier — halos a touch wider than the lens should give; faint pattern-recognition lift (early sharpenHalo).
Common: starbursts on every light source + first episodic eye-wiggle bursts, eased in and out rather than snapping (spike-curve jitter — bursts, never constant).

Strong: constant fine shimmer on bright regions, frequent soft wiggle; a faint dim monotone blue-grey geometric hint starts riding textures (patternMask/symmetry, low weight, psilocin-like rather than LSD-like per PsychonautWiki).

Heavy: doubled starbursts (late doubleVision), stronger contrast/color lift so the bloom stack peaks properly, soft judder, peripheral shadow-flicker at low weight, the faint geometry hint fully present but still just a hint.
